CIV.note: Workshop on RSU interoperability names ONECI as a partner system but states no check of people against the national ID.

facts.fact: A 7-11 September 2025 workshop at Grand-Bassam, run by the Ministry of National Cohesion through the Filets Sociaux programme office, aims to update the Registre Social Unique's interoperability framework for data sharing between SIG-RSU and CNAM, CNPS, CGRAE, ONECI, WURI and DOB.

systems.owner: Ministry of National Cohesion, Solidarity and Fight against Poverty (Filets Sociaux)
